Name: CP-Glass bottle mailbox(Four seasons)
Author: Sunnyang0w0
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

*스타듀밸리 네이버 카페에 업로드 했던 모드와 동일한 모드입니다! 해외 유저분들께도 쉽게 배포하기 위해 넥서스에도 올려용~*

[size=4]Adds 4 seasonal textures to turn your mailbox into a glass bottle. [/size]
[size=4]Works with any farm type! You can turn the grass option on and off[/size]

After launching Stardew Valley, open the [CP] Glass Bottle Mailbox file in Mods and change the Config file from false to true to enable or disable the grass option. The default is false.
If you are using the GenericModConfigMenu mod, you can also change this in-game!

[size=4]Versions compatible with update 1.6 are available, and versions for 1.5.[/size]
[size=4]Please download the version that matches the game you are using[/size]


I used a translator to write the explanation, but I'm not sure if it turned out properly😅
영어 너무 어렵다...

[b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[size=3]Just extract this mod into the \Stardew Valley\Mods\  and place it there[/size]
